title: Without + 1 the count of rows with a larger value is BLANK for the top row, not 0
query: EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS ( Product, "Product", Product[Product], "Higher", COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( Product, Product[Price] > EARLIER ( Product[Price] ) ) ) )

source.quote: This technique returns a blank or zero value for the highest value in the table
source.supports: the highest value has no row above it

source.quote: If the table has no rows, COUNTROWS returns BLANK , not 0.
source.supports: COUNTROWS of the empty filtered table is BLANK

derivation: SELECTCOLUMNS iterates Product; FILTER opens a second row context on Product and EARLIER reads the price of the SELECTCOLUMNS row. Bike 100: no larger price, empty table, BLANK. Scooter 50: Bike, 1. Helmet 20: Bike and Scooter, 2. Lock 10: 3.
